studentStatistics.note: Official status counts and record-completeness counts are separate dimensions and may overlap.

merit.methodology: Semester toppers use the highest verified official SGPA in each semester and retain ties. CGPA ranking uses only students with all six semester records, sorts verified overall CGPA descending, retains ties, and displays ranks through position 10.

mzParticipants.participantRule: Pre-Medical participation is evidenced by at least one positive MZ grade point; placeholder-only zero MZ rows are excluded.
mzParticipants.statusRule: Verified MZ grade point 2.0-4.0 = Pass; 0.0 = Fail; missing or invalid = Unknown.

limitations: Subject status is derived from the verified final grade-point field: 2.0–4.0 passed and 0.0 supply/non-passed.
MZ Zero Mathematics courses are excluded because sample calculations confirm they do not contribute to SGPA.
Course marks, credit hours, letter grades, and quality points remain unavailable.
4 workbook/PDF numeric conflicts are documented; workbook values are used consistently.

classificationRules.passed: Official semester status Promoted, Pass, or Passed.
classificationRules.failed: Official semester status containing Fail, Supply, Supplementary, Dropped, or Probation.
classificationRules.unknown: Missing or unrecognized official semester status; GPA is not used to infer status.
classificationRules.missing: No semester record for the student; missing records are not classified as failures.
